blocks.heading: Btech: Still the Widest High-Salary Lane, Branch-Dependent

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: Salary: ₹4-6 LPA at service-based recruiters, ₹12-30+ LPA at product-based tech recruiters from top-tier institutes.

figures.label: Total Education Cost
figures.source: NLU fees run roughly Rs 2.5-5 lakh a year (about Rs 13-20 lakh across five years), gated by CLAT, a genuinely competitive national exam for a limited number of NLU seats. Corporate law firm offers from NLU batches commonly start at Rs 8-20+ LPA. The same BA LLB title from a private, non-NLU law college without that entrance filter typically starts much lower, often Rs 4-6 LPA.

blocks.heading: BCom + CA: Slow Start, Strong Compounding

figures.label: Total Education Cost
figures.source: Total registration, coaching, and exam cost across the CA route is typically Rs 1-3 lakh, far below an IIT, NLU, or NID fee.

figures.label: Entry Level Pay
figures.source: A freshly qualified CA usually starts at Rs 7-12 LPA, with Big 4 firms and corporate finance roles reaching Rs 20-35+ LPA by mid-career.

figures.label: Qualification Time Window
figures.source: The full route, including a mandatory articleship, typically takes about 4.5-5 years, similar to a BTech or BArch timeline.

figures.label: Education Budget Example
figures.source: An illustration, not a real fee: on a ₹3 lakh education budget, a tenth is ₹30,000 for the main course and a fifth is ₹60,000.

figures.label: Total Education Cost
figures.source: Fee: Roughly Rs 50,000-1.3 lakh a year at government colleges, Rs 2-6 lakh a year at private colleges.

figures.label: Entry Level Pay
figures.source: Salary: Rs 3-6 LPA at entry, rising to Rs 10-20 LPA by 5-7 years with a strong portfolio and Council of Architecture registration.

figures.label: Entry Level Pay
figures.source: Entry pay in India typically runs Rs 1.8-3.5 LPA (roughly Rs 15,000-40,000 a month) against fees of Rs 3-10 lakh a year. The real upside usually shows up later, through cruise-line postings, Gulf and international hotel-chain roles, or a 5-8 year climb through operations into management, not a fast domestic jump straight after graduation.

blocks.heading: How to Actually Read a "Salary" Number

figures.label: Proof Milestone Window
figures.source: CA, BArch, and BTech all show a wide gap between entry pay and pay 5-7 years in. A course that starts modestly (architecture, hospitality) can still compound well if the field itself has a real growth curve.

blocks.heading: Four Questions Before You Pick One Course

figures.label: Total Course Duration
figures.source: Do you want desk-and-screen work (software, CA, design), people-facing work (nursing, hospitality, law court work), or site-based work (architecture, civil)? A 3-5 year degree commits you to a daily rhythm, not just a subject.

blocks.heading: Course to Your Stream and Constraints

items.text: PCM: BTech (via JEE), BArch (via NATA/JEE Paper 2) are the direct-fit routes.
PCB: nursing and allied health degrees use your biology base directly; BArch and BTech generally require PCM instead.
Both PCM and PCB students remain eligible for BBA, BCA, BA LLB, BDes, BHM, and the CA route without restriction.
